name: webdav-easyaccess
description: WebDAV file management service with Google Drive-like UI

scripts.dev:e2e:server:s3: node scripts/e2e/wait-healthy.mjs && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../data/e2e-runtime.env NODE_ENV=test npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev:e2e:server:webdav: E2E_BACKEND_MODE=webdav node scripts/e2e/wait-healthy.mjs && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../data/e2e-runtime.env NODE_ENV=test npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.check: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && npm run check:e2e && npm run check:format
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace server && npm run test:unit --workspace client
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace server && npm run test:integration --workspace client
scripts.test:pg: npm run test:pg:adapters && npm run test:pg:vector
scripts.test:mutation: npm run test:mutation --workspace server && npm run test:mutation --workspace client
scripts.e2e:release: npm run e2e:release:model-off && npm run e2e:release:model-on && npm run e2e:release:webdav
scripts.e2e:release:model-off: E2E_PROFILE=release E2E_EXPECTED_SKIPS=6 E2E_GROUP=default E2E_BACKEND_MODE=s3 WEA_SKIP_EMBED_MODEL=1 playwright test --retries=0
scripts.e2e:release:model-on: E2E_PROFILE=release E2E_EXPECTED_SKIPS=6 E2E_GROUP=default E2E_BACKEND_MODE=s3 playwright test --retries=0
scripts.e2e:release:webdav: E2E_PROFILE=release E2E_EXPECTED_SKIPS=0 E2E_GROUP=webdav E2E_BACKEND_MODE=webdav WEA_SKIP_EMBED_MODEL=1 playwright test --retries=0
scripts.gate:full: env -u WEA_TEST_PG_HOST -u WEA_TEST_PG_PORT -u WEA_TEST_PG_USER -u WEA_TEST_PG_PASSWORD -u WEA_TEST_PG_DATABASE npm run gate && npm run test:pg && npm run e2e:release
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace shared
